sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: State in a few sentences what this policy protects and why.

sections.heading: Who and what it applies to
sections.body: Name the people, systems and information this policy covers.

sections.heading: What the organization requires
sections.body:
Write each rule as a short, plain sentence that someone could check.
Use 'must' for what is required and 'may' for what is allowed.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
sections.body: Name the roles that carry out and oversee the rules.

sections.heading: Exceptions
sections.body: Say how an exception is asked for, who may grant it and how it is recorded.

sections.heading: Review
sections.body: Say how often the policy is reviewed and who approves changes.
